Import a dated Raspberry Pi OS Lite Trixie image.

## Configurations

Architecture-specific configurations replace the default configuration. The
default is used when no matching architecture override exists.

### arm64

| Setting    | Value                                                                                                                                 |
| ---------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Import URL | https://downloads.raspberrypi.com/raspios_lite_arm64/images/raspios_lite_arm64-2026-04-14/2026-04-13-raspios-trixie-arm64-lite.img.xz |

## Behavior

Imports the configured Raspberry Pi OS Lite image for arm64. The source URL pins
a dated image rather than following the newest release. Add
core/rpi-raspios-setup when adapting the imported system for Rugix.

## Example

For example, choose this base for a project layer:

```toml
parent = "core/raspios-trixie"
```
